title: Accuracy of Artificial Intelligence-Based Automated Quantitative Coronary Angiography Compared to Intravascular Ultrasound: Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary: In 47 patients with 54 significant coronary lesions, AI-QCA measurements showed moderate-to-strong correlation with IVUS for proximal reference area (r=0.57), distal reference area (r=0.80) and minimal luminal area (r=0.52); correlation was weaker for percent area stenosis (r=0.29) and lesion length (r=0.33). Correcting proximal/distal margin mismatch strengthened reference-area correlations to r=0.70 and r=0.83, respectively.
ai_technology: Fully automated artificial-intelligence quantitative coronary angiography (AI-QCA) measured coronary lesion dimensions for comparison with IVUS; adjusting lesion margins reduced geographic mismatch.
